import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
print(f"Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
print("---")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    styles = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
    style_val = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val") if styles else None
    # Gather text content (w:t and w:delText) of the paragraph
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:delText"):
        texts.append("[del] " + (t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else ""))
    content = "".join(texts).strip()
    print(f"[{i}] style={style_val} | {content[:100]}")

import defusedxml.minidom as minidom
import re

doc = minidom.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
paras = doc.getElementsByTagName("w:p")

# Existing tracked changes?
ins = doc.getElementsByTagName("w:ins")
dele = doc.getElementsByTagName("w:del")
print(f"Existing <w:ins>: {len(ins)}, <w:del>: {len(dele)}")

print("--- Candidate headlines (non-empty, all-caps-ish text) ---")
candidates = []
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild and t.firstChild.nodeType == 3 else "")
    content = "".join(texts).strip()
    if not content:
        continue
    # All-caps detection: no lowercase letters
    is_caps = not re.search(r"[a-z]", content)
    if is_caps:
        candidates.append(i)
        print(f"[{i}] {content!r}")
print("---")
print("Candidate indices:", candidates)
